name: Huankunmon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 level 3 blue Digimon card from one of your blue Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 of your other blue Digimon as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, unsuspend this Digimon.
